title: Equisetum arvense cream for medicinal use
intro: Equisetum arvense cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the powdered plant known as field horsetail, which is rich in silica and other minerals. It is traditionally used in herbalism to support skin health, reduce inflammation, and promote healing of wounds and skin conditions. The cream is often applied directly to the skin to alleviate symptoms of eczema, psoriasis, and other inflammatory disorders. Its astringent properties are believed to help tighten tissues and improve circulation. Due to its potency, it is typically used under the guidance of a qualified herbalist or healthcare provider.
